decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. Cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt help to filter through the deck, while spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal and trigger the Phoenix's ability. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Ashiok, Dream Render and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's strategy. Overall, the goal is to be aggressive and efficient in bringing back Arclight Phoenix to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Amalia Benavides Aguirre alongside cards like Chord of Calling, Collected Company, and Return to the Ranks to generate a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards that help with mana fixing and ramp, as well as protection for key combo pieces. By utilizing cards like Fauna Shaman and Razorverge Thicket, the deck aims to efficiently search for combo pieces and maintain card advantage. The ultimate goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game through a burst of powerful synergies.

The focus of this deck is on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard while applying pressure to the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The deck aims to utilize cards like Opt, Treasure Cruise, Consider, and Lightning Axe to enable the recursion of Arclight Phoenix and apply consistent pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Ledger Shredder also helps to support this strategy by providing additional ways to bring back Arclight Phoenix and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Dimir Rogue tribe to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while also building up a powerful board presence. With cards like Thieves' Guild Enforcer and Soaring Thought-Thief, the deck aims to mill the opponent's deck while dealing damage and gaining card advantage. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's plays. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's plans, and grind out wins through a combination of aggression and control.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells and then use cards like Arclight Phoenix and Ledger Shredder to bring them back from the graveyard for repeated attacks. The deck also includes counter spells like Spell Pierce and disruptive cards like Picklock Prankster to control the board and protect the aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Galvanic Iteration adds flexibility and the ability to adapt to different situations, while the powerful card draw abilities from Opt, Consider, and Treasure Cruise help maintain consistency and fuel the graveyard recursion strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a variety of versatile spells and removal options. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and board presence. The inclusion of Niv-Mizzet Reborn allows for powerful card advantage and selection, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value and synergy with the deck's strategy. The mana base is diverse to support the deck's multicolor requirements, ensuring consistent access to the necessary colors for spells and abilities.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive cards. Utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Dusk Legion Zealot, and Vein Ripper, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. Additionally, the deck includes strong finishers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to seal the deal. By combining aggression with disruption, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Utilizing lands like Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while maintaining control through targeted removal and hand disruption spells. The deck's strategy is to overwhelm and outpace the opponent in the early game to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use spells like Consider, Opt, and Sleight of Hand to fill up the graveyard with instants and sorceries in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck also includes Treasure Cruise to refill the hand and maintain card advantage. Hall of Storm Giants can be used as a finisher to close out games quickly. Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse help to deal with threats on the board, while Picklock Prankster provides a way to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and resource management to overwhelm the opponent.

The key concept of this UW Control deck is to use a variety of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw effects to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck focuses on maintaining card advantage through card draw effects like Memory Deluge and Dig Through Time, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to control the board state. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional threat and synergizes well with the rest of the deck's control elements. Ultimately, the goal is to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful life gain combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre as the key card. Utilizing creatures like Wildgrowth Walker and Lunarch Veteran to gain life triggers while ramping with Prosperous Innkeeper and Fauna Shaman to search for combo pieces. Return to the Ranks and Chord of Calling are used to bring back key creatures and find necessary combo pieces. The deck also includes some disruptive creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Selfless Savior for protection. Aetherflux Reservoir serves as a finisher once a high life total is achieved.

This Aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to revive Arclight Phoenix multiple times. Ledger Shredder helps facilitate this strategy by milling cards, while cards like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse provide removal for opposing threats. Treasure Cruise allows for card draw and Galvanic Iteration can create additional copies of key spells. The deck also includes counterspells like Spell Pierce for protection. With a mix of card filtering, graveyard interaction, and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with repeated Phoenix resurrections and strong tempo plays.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper, while using Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provide additional utility and synergy with the vampire tribal theme of the deck. By establishing a fast and aggressive board presence, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering opponent's spells and controlling the board with a variety of removal and disruption spells. It also includes card draw and card selection to ensure the player has answers to threats. The deck uses a mix of counter spells, removal, and planeswalkers to slow down the opponent's game plan and eventually take over the game with powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The mana base is built to support its control strategy with lands that can produce both white and blue mana efficiently.

This deck focuses on using a combination of tempo control and aggressive creatures, particularly spirits, to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. Cards like Spell Queller and Spell Pierce help to counter key spells, while creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom empower the rest of the spirit creatures to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes support cards like Smuggler's Copter and Wedding Announcement to further bolster its aggressive strategy. The combination of disruption and aggression makes it a versatile and formidable deck in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck aims to use the synergy between Lotus Field and various untap effects to generate a large amount of mana quickly. By untapping Lotus Field through cards like Hidden Strings or Vizier of Tumbling Sands, the deck can ramp into powerful spells like Omniscience or Emergent Ultimatum. The deck also includes toolbox cards like Fae of Wishes to find the perfect answer for any situation. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful spells and clever maneuvering of mana resources.
